Title: This Website
Description:
Initially built by hand using good old plain html, css & a bit of js sprinkled in, by now I've swapped to a more modern toolkit.
The current version of the website uses Mudblazor, which has allowed me to step up both functionalities and design while still allowing more customization than an out-of-the box website host.
If you are interested in checking out the old version of my website/portfolio click here. It is no longer maintained, but images & most links should still be working fine.

Title: Own Projects
Description: The projects in this category are those I've created myself in my spare time. Many of these are just prototypes - as it commonly happens with game/software development - but I'd love to get around to expanding upon these eventually.

Title: brainboost Projects
Description: Here you can find some projects I've worked on for current position at brainboost, where I do both game & software development pre-dominently in a Neurofeedback context

Title: Student Assistant Projects
Description:
These are the projects I worked on during my student job at the Technical University of Munich's Chair for Augmented Medical Procedures & Augmented Reality (CAMPAR) or more precisely, its research group "Forschungsgruppe Augmented Reality" (FAR).
My tasks there revolved around expanding, optimizing, and maintaining older projects, such mobile apps, custom made Bluetooth gadgets/research tools, and VR studies.

Title: University Projects
Description: These projects I developed during my time at the Technical University of Munich. They include everything from theory-heavy simulations over multiplayer platformers to serious games. Some of these games were developed alone and others in groups of up to 8 people.
